基于 Xray-core 的跨平台节点管理客户端，支持多协议节点、订阅和灵活的规则路由。

适用平台[Android](https://huarun.win/platform/android)[iOS](https://huarun.win/platform/ios)[Windows](https://huarun.win/platform/windows)[macOS](https://huarun.win/platform/macos)[Linux](https://huarun.win/platform/linux)

完整功能费用 免费

代理内核 Xray[了解 Xray-core 内核 →](https://huarun.win/cores/xray)[查看依据](https://github.com/Happ-proxy/happ-desktop/blob/bd22000fc1446d1e8516be67dda4266f46bd8fd7/README.md)

主导开发[Happ Proxy 团队](https://huarun.win/history/people/happ-proxy)Happ

版本号 4.2.1

最后更新时间 2026年9月4日

数据来源 GitHub 桌面版

## 官方变更日志

- Improved Xray TUN is now the default tunnel provider and appears first in the provider pickers
- Improved ping tests are more reliable and no longer leave stray helper processes running
- Improved the Windows installer now ships fully signed binaries
-
- Added a Reset action that repairs the background service on Windows, macOS and Linux, with its health checks included in the diagnostic report
- Added an editable system proxy exception list in Advanced settings
- Added Per-App Proxy support when running Xray TUN
-
- Fixed encrypted subscriptions revealing their server details after the first refresh
- Fixed subscriptions failing to decrypt when delivered through a fronting proxy
- Fixed subscription links that redirect to a happ:// address not being added
- Fixed server configs that use the vcn alias for certificate verification not importing
- Fixed DNS going dead on Xray TUN
- Fixed proxy ping showing n/a on Xray TUN
- Fixed the buttons and AI Helper disappearing after deleting the last server from the list
- Fixed LAN sharing showing a virtual machine adapter address instead of the real local network one
- Fixed no error appearing when an invalid routing profile is imported in global routing settings
- Fixed the HTTP inbound toggle and user agent fields staying greyed out after a subscription lost premium
- Fixed the tunnel type from a subscription not being applied to free subscriptions[查看官方版本来源 ↗](https://github.com/Happ-proxy/happ-desktop/releases/tag/4.2.1)

Happ is a mobile application designed for convenient proxy server management, powered by the robust Xray core. The app features an intuitive interface and a range of useful functions, making it an essential tool for managing connections.

**Key features of Happ include:**

* Configuration of proxy servers based on flexible routing rules.
* Support for multiple modern protocols, including:
  * **VLESS (Reality)**
  * **VMess**
  * **Trojan**
  * **Shadowsocks**
  * **Socks**

Happ ensures your network activity remains private by not collecting any data; your information remains solely on your device without being sent to external servers.

It's important to highlight that Happ does not provide VPN services for purchase. Users are responsible for acquiring or setting up their own servers. Users should also comply with applicable laws in their jurisdiction when utilizing the app.

To report a problem, use our [service](https://issues.happ.su/)
